title: Robert Saleh says he and Liam Coen are good after "misunderstanding" last year

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Robert Saleh says he and Liam Coen are good after "misunderstanding" last year
sources.description: When the Titans face the Jaguars on Sunday, Robert Saleh and Liam Coen will coach against each other for the first time since their run-in last year, when they exchanged words on the field over something Saleh, then the defensive coordinator of the 49ers, said something about Coen that Coen didn't appreciate.
